description: This Java class defines a REST controller 'AttachmentController' for managing email attachments in a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints for uploading files, downloading attachments, and listing attachments associated with a specific email ID, with security and user authentication handling.

classes.name: AttachmentController
classes.description: REST controller for handling email attachment operations, including upload, download, and listing attachments.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on the Authentication object.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading of one or multiple files to associate with a specified email ID, for the authenticated user.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading of a specific attachment by its ID, returning the file resource with appropriate headers.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all attachments associated with a specific email ID for the authenticated user.
